name: Explicit intent
principle: Every built part traces to the problems it addresses and the ideals it pursues.
state_description: Opening any file, you can see which solution it serves, why that solution exists and what better would mean for it, without asking anyone.
hints_of_measurement: Every file reaches a solution and every solution reaches a problem and an ideal.

name: Metric-chosen defaults
principle: The implementation that runs is the one the solution's authoritative metric ranks best.
state_description: When an alternative measures better it becomes the default without debate; when results tie, the record says so and why the default was kept.
hints_of_measurement: Every selected implementation is the measured winner or a declared tie.

name: Trustworthy evidence
principle: Every number can be reproduced from the code and the cases that produced it, and only like is compared with like.
state_description: Seeing a result, you know exactly what code and cases produced it and can rerun it; numbers live in one place and are never retyped.
hints_of_measurement: Every result carries its commit and case hash on clean code, and no number appears outside the results.

name: Effortless substitution
principle: Switching the implementation of a solution changes no code that depends on it.
state_description: An operator or an embedding system picks a different implementation by name, and a mistyped name stops with the valid choices.
hints_of_measurement: Switching needs no call-site edit and an unknown name always fails loudly.

name: Review by metric
principle: People can steer by reviewing problems, ideals, metrics and results alone, without needing to read implementations; anyone may still review or improve an implementation, and that still adds value.
state_description: Joshua opens one sheet, sees each solution's ideal, metric, current result and verdict, corrects any of them there, and the correction reaches the source.
hints_of_measurement: Every review decision can be made and recorded from the sheet.

name: Faithful measurement
principle: What is measured is what ships.
state_description: Every evaluation drives the live code path, so a better score means better behaviour for users.
hints_of_measurement: Every measured implementation calls shipped code, and every case set can tell a broken implementation from a sound one.

name: Declared once
principle: Each fact is stated once, where it belongs, and every place that shows it agrees with it without anyone keeping a copy in step.
state_description: Adding an alternative is writing it: the records, the measurement and the default know of it without retyping, and a person writes only what the code cannot say.
hints_of_measurement: No decision is written in two files by hand, and what the code declares is in the records without being retyped.

name: Best available implementation
principle: A solution is served by the best implementation anyone can offer for its job, not by the one that was built first or is most familiar.
state_description: The implementations selected for solutions always reflect the best alternative available across all known resources and methods.
hints_of_measurement: Each selected implementation is the leader of its solution's leaderboard, the alternatives on that board include the ones outside evidence points to (public results graded before any paid run), and a better alternative that appears is measured and promoted rather than left unread.

name: Purposeful code
principle: Nothing exists that serves no solution, and every part is small enough to understand in one reading.
state_description: The repository holds only what earns its place, each module has one role, and deleting dead code is routine.
hints_of_measurement: No file without a component, no component without a solution, no module over the size ceiling.

name: Timely affordable evidence
principle: Every choice between alternatives is backed by a current result, and what it cost to get was proportionate to the choice and approved.
state_description: Before choosing, anyone can see when each alternative was measured, on which commit and cases, and whether what it measures has changed since; each metric was run when a decision needed it and its cost was worth what it taught.
hints_of_measurement: Every selection cites a current result, no paid run lacks an approval, and the number of stale results found late stays near zero.

name: Sound integration
principle: A system built on a library meets the same standard as the library, through the library's own checks and cases.
state_description: The embedding system knows which library solution each of its parts serves, its own stores pass the library's cases, and it sees at once when its pin falls behind.
hints_of_measurement: The embedding's check passes with no unmapped part, no unscored store and no unexplained lag.

name: Navigable records
principle: A person opening a code folder finds the specification of what it holds beside it, and a person opening a specification finds its code one folder away.
state_description: Each solution's records live once, in the folder that holds its code. Every folder that holds an implementation has a generated README with the solution, its implementations, its entry call and the selected arm, its metrics and links up to the intent and down to the folders below it. From the repository's top README every solution's spec is within three clicks, and no record is kept in two places.
hints_of_measurement: For each solution of each repository measured: spec and code in the same folder or one link apart, spec within three clicks of the top README, no duplicated record, a README in every code folder that holds an implementation, and the same pages when generated again.

name: An application's records say only what is its own
principle: An application's records describe what only the application has, and a reader sees at once which jobs it borrows from a library and which it defines.
state_description: A job a library defines has one definition, the library's, and the application's records point to it. The application's own records hold its own needs in full, with their metrics, customization and code. A solution that proves general lives in the library from then on, and the application points to it.
hints_of_measurement: Share of an application's solution records that restate a library solution; share of references that resolve; whether a reader can name, for each solution, whether it is adopted, specialized or the application's own.

name: Proportionate structure
principle: The structure costs less than it returns, and a small change carries a small cost.
state_description: Contributors find the structure helps them, small fixes stay small, and parts of the structure that stop paying are removed.
hints_of_measurement: The effort and time the structure adds to a change stays small next to what it catches.

name: Rules earn their place
principle: Every rule can say which mistake it prevents, and is removed when it stops catching any.
state_description: Asking why a rule exists, or why its limit has its value, is answered from a record, and a rule that has caught nothing for a long time is listed for removal.
hints_of_measurement: The share of rules with a recorded reason, and the share that caught something in the period.

name: Self-evolving structure
principle: The structure notices where it falls short and improves itself at the moment a change makes it worse.
state_description: An agent who has never read the rules sees each finding as it happens, with the rule, the path and the next step, and rules that stop catching anything fall away.
hints_of_measurement: The share of injected violations reported by the right rule and path, the share of clean trees never flagged, and how many rules caught nothing over a month.

name: Well-divided work
principle: Each solution has one job, each part is small enough to read whole, and parts connect only through what they declare.
state_description: A newcomer or an AI agent can say what each solution is for, change one without reading its neighbors, and a refactor keeps the behavior production uses.
hints_of_measurement: One balanced number across scope, size, coupling, reuse, flow fidelity, public surface and preserved behavior, with the worst offenders of each dimension named.

name: Principled behaviour
principle: An AI agent acts by the principles in its own work, including holding back where structure costs more than it returns, and keeps every qualifier when it restates one.
state_description: Given a task, the agent does the sized, fitting thing: a one-line fix stays a one-line fix, a repeated copy becomes one shared place, a task is recognised as a task and not recorded as a problem, and the closing summary says how the principles were applied. A person who corrects it finds the correction recorded where the next session reads it.
hints_of_measurement: On cases that name the expected behaviour and the failure, the share of replies that act by the principle is high for every principle and higher than the same agent without the instructions, and the cases that need restraint or a kept qualifier pass as often as the cases that need structure.

name: Found structure
principle: Structure that already exists is found and reused instead of rediscovered.
state_description: Starting work in any project, you are told which projects ESOI is applied to here, how they relate and which file to read first, and the guidance itself names none of them.
hints_of_measurement: A question about where to look in a project is answered from the person's own index, including projects added after the guidance was written.

name: Glanceable intent
principle: Anyone clicking into an intent folder sees on the first screen what the intent is, how its solutions fit together and where to go next.
state_description: A person who clicks into any intent folder knows within the first screen what the intent is for, how its solutions fit together and which folder or file to open next, without opening a record file. Everything they read agrees with the records, and nothing in the records is hidden from someone who reads on.
hints_of_measurement: Every intent folder's page passes the first-screen, solution-row, link, finished-text, determinism and size checks; a person comparing the layouts side by side opens the selected one first.

name: Right specification at the right time
principle: For any new use case or input, whoever applies a project's specifications works from the few that bear on it, at a small fraction of the cost of reading them all.
state_description: A person or an AI starting on a new request has in front of it the specifications that bear on it, each with its linked records, and none that do not. Nothing relevant is missed, and nothing is read in full that was not needed.
hints_of_measurement: For labelled requests, the expected records are among the top few results, and the scan of every record is a small fraction of the records' full size.

name: Shared specification search
principle: An application that finds specifications for a request writes only what is its own, and every improvement to finding them reaches it without a change on its side.
state_description: An application's code for finding specifications holds only its own parts, such as its vector search and its judging prompt. When finding specifications improves in the library, every application that relies on it gets the improvement on its next upgrade.
hints_of_measurement: Offline cases over the live records pass, and an adopter holds no function that reads the same with its domain words removed.

name: Adoptable structure
principle: Another team can apply the same structure to its own code by following one standard and reusing this library's tools.
state_description: A developer reads the standard, adds records and an evaluation folder, runs the same checks, and has measured selection in their own repository.
hints_of_measurement: A new solution or a new repository reaches a passing check by following the standard alone.

name: Stale only when what it measures changed
principle: A recorded result goes stale if and only if the code, cases or circumstances it measures changed.
state_description: Touching code, cases or documents that a result does not measure leaves that result current, and touching anything it does measure is reported against that result with the changed file and the component that owns it; no result is kept whose measured code changed.
hints_of_measurement: Across a fixture of commits, no result is kept whose measured code changed (a hard fail) and the results re-run for nothing are few.

name: Living template
principle: When the template's author refines it, every record and every tool that reads records follows.
state_description: Joshua refines a field in the skill, the registry learns of it on the next check, and the missing entries are named.
hints_of_measurement: The registry's fields always match the skill's template, and every record fills every required field.

name: Calibrated judging
principle: A judge's verdicts agree with the human verdicts they stand in for, and where they disagree is known.
state_description: A reviewer opens the judge's verdicts beside their own on the same replies and finds few disagreements, each one named as a kind (too strict on restraint, too lenient on keywords). When the model behind the judge changes, the disagreement is measured again before the behaviour scores are trusted.
hints_of_measurement: Agreement with human verdicts on held-out replies, with false passes and false fails counted apart, and the share of labels that are a person's own.

name: Installable skill
principle: A stranger gets the author's current skill, complete and public-safe, in one step, while the author keeps one source of truth.
state_description: Someone adds the skill to their agent with one command or one download, reads it with no other context, and later gets the author's refinements. The author edits one folder and the public copy follows, with nothing private in it.
hints_of_measurement: The public copy equals what the source would generate, no check finds a private term or path in it, and installing it takes one command and no checkout.

name: Followable process
principle: Anyone applying ESOI can follow one stated order from purpose to selection by metric, sized to the work, and knows where to return when something changes.
state_description: A newcomer or an AI agent opens the steps, works through them without asking what comes next, skips a step only with a stated reason, and ends with linked records, a metric shown to tell good from bad, and a selection made by it. When something changes they go straight to the step it touches.
hints_of_measurement: Per trial: steps completed, skipped with a reason and skipped silently; times the person asked what to do next; whether the result passes the structure check with a checked metric. Silent skips and questions fall over trials.
